title: A parity lower bound for bounded-depth quantum circuits with polynomial ancillas
exact_target: Fix depth d, total-qubit exponent $c\geq 1$ and $\epsilon >0$. For all sufficiently large input lengths n, is parity impossible with success at least 1/2+epsilon on every input using depth-d circuits of arbitrary one-qubit gates and unbounded-arity Toffoli gates on at most $n^c$ qubits, layers of disjoint supports, zero-state ancillas and one measured output qubit?
